title: Honkai: Star Rail

anticheat.note: kernel-level anti-cheat, broken under Wine on Linux too

provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#798, 2026-10-29), the Epic copy, Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal with AVX advertised, rated 1 of 5: a black window, the same on DXMT. Not verified by the maintainer. udance4ever again on highball-db#798 (2026-11-16), the Wine 10 engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r31, D3DMetal: HYP.exe, miHoYo's own launcher in the game's folder, gives a black window too, and its log shows the launcher's embedded browser starting its GPU process again after crash after crash (exit code 0xC0000005). In CrossOver HYP.exe downloaded the game, where launcher_epic.exe stayed black as in Highball, and the downloaded game crashed while starting Unity.
notes: Does not start in Highball: a black window on D3DMetal and DXMT (Epic, M1). The game ships miHoYo's anti-cheat, which is listed as broken under Wine on Linux as well, so it is most likely out of reach. HYP.exe, miHoYo's own launcher, shows a black window in Highball as well, its embedded browser's GPU process crashing over and over. In CrossOver it downloaded the game, which then crashed while starting Unity (highball-db#798).

knownIssues.symptom: A black window on D3DMetal and DXMT
knownIssues.cause: assumed: the game's anti-cheat, which fails under Wine on Linux too. Not measured
